body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-30 15:33Z, my own repeated slip). Twice in 15 minutes after restart 1, I gave the Central cargo slot to two sessions at once. First, Coder 7422's c7e0 focused run and Merger3's Engram release build overlapped at 15:18–15:20Z. Then my "Central GO" to Merger3 at 15:28Z was followed by me authorizing Coder's next focused check at 15:31Z, and both launched around 15:32Z. Cause: I hand out GOs per conversation without one ordered Central queue, and a hold message arrives too late when the recipient is mid-turn. Rule: keep ONE explicit Central owner at a time. Before ANY GO or step that implies a cargo run on Central (including "run one focused check" inside a continuation), check who holds Central. If someone else holds it, put the next job in a queued position and give no GO. Release only on that job's END mail.
